{"access":"read_only","command":"/Users/jiangtao/Desktop/open-harness/apps/desktop/resources/workspace-runtime/node/bin/node -e 'const fs=require(\"node:fs\"); const p=\"outputs/continuity.json\"; const x=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,\"utf8\")); const assert=require(\"node:assert/strict\"); assert.deepEqual(x.refund_ids,[\"R301\",\"R302\",\"R303\"]); assert.equal(x.applied_refund,60); assert.equal(x.net_received,415); assert.equal(x.unpaid_before_refunds,225); assert.equal(typeof x.unpaid_before_refunds,\"number\"); assert.ok(Array.isArray(x.evidence)); assert.ok(x.evidence.every(v=>typeof v===\"string\")); assert.ok(x.evidence.some(v=>v.includes(\"CORRECTION-ORCHID\")&&v.includes(\"event #4\")&&v.includes(\"R303 已经人工核实为 settled\"))); assert.ok(x.evidence.some(v=>v.includes(\"refunds.csv\")&&v.includes(\"R301\")&&v.includes(\"R304\"))); assert.ok(x.evidence.some(v=>v.includes(\"payments.csv\")&&v.includes(\"P201\")&&v.includes(\"P207\"))); assert.ok(x.evidence.some(v=>v.includes(\"orders.csv\")&&v.includes(\"O106\"))); assert.equal(475-x.applied_refund,x.net_received); console.log(\"JSON parse and assertions passed; refund sum 30+20+10=60, net 475-60=415, unpaid 60+75+90=225.\");'","network_access":"denied","access":"read_only","yield_time_ms":10000}
